boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain South Dakota State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Brookings food and convenience stops with currently published late hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 1809 6th Street, Brookings
cards.notes: Use the Village Square location for cookies or ice cream when you need a late dessert option; confirm holiday changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated late-night cookie and ice-cream stop on 6th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Brookings lists Insomnia Cookies at 1809 6th Street and says it serves treats until midnight or later every day.
cards.access_notes: The published listing says service continues until midnight or later every day; verify same-day hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 25th Avenue
cards.subtitle: 926 25th Ave., Brookings
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or delivery options at this Wilbert Square location; drive-thru hours run later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service option with late drive-thru availability every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours through 1 a.m. Sunday-Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday-Saturday at 926 25th Ave.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 1 a.m. Sunday-Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday-Saturday. Dining-room hours are earlier.

cards.title: Wendy's on 6th Street
cards.subtitle: 2324 6th St., Brookings
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru for a late meal on 6th Street; both published schedules match, including the later weekend close.
cards.short_summary: A 6th Street stop open to 11 p.m. most nights and midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 11 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and midnight Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru close at 11 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and midnight Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.subtitle: 2205 E. 6th Street, Brookings
cards.notes: Plan for a seated meal, bakery item, pickup, or delivery at this East 6th Street restaurant; weekend hours extend to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A full-service and bakery option with midnight Friday-Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists 6 a.m.-11 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and 6 a.m.-midnight Friday-Saturday at 2205 E. 6th Street.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours are until 11 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and until midnight Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Casey's on 22nd Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 534 22nd Ave. S, Brookings
cards.notes: Stop for convenience items or prepared food near campus; use pickup or delivery only within the listed service window.
cards.short_summary: A south-side convenience and prepared-food stop open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's lists its 534 22nd Ave. S store, pump, pickup, and delivery hours as 4 a.m.-11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Store and pump hours are 4 a.m.-11 p.m. daily; pickup and delivery end at 10:30 p.m.

cards.title: Casey's on 8th Street South
cards.subtitle: 620 8th St. S, Brookings
cards.notes: Use this separate Casey's location for snacks or kitchen items, and check the listed pickup cutoff if ordering ahead.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Brookings Casey's location that stays open through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's lists its 620 8th St. S store and pump hours as 5 a.m.-midnight daily, with pickup and delivery until 11:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Store and pump are listed until midnight daily; pickup and delivery are listed until 11:30 p.m.

cards.title: QDOBA on 6th Street
cards.subtitle: 2320 6th St., Brookings
cards.notes: Build a burrito, bowl, tacos, or quesadilla for takeout or dine-in; this is the off-campus QDOBA, not the Student Union counter.
cards.short_summary: An off-campus customizable Mexican-food option open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: QDOBA lists the 2320 6th St. Brookings restaurant open 10:30 a.m.-10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 10:30 a.m.-10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Taco John's on Medary Avenue
cards.subtitle: 609 Medary Ave., Brookings
cards.notes: Use the Medary Avenue restaurant for a late fast-food meal; its published closing time varies by day, so check the schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A Medary Avenue option with several 11 p.m. or midnight closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco John's lists closing at midnight Wednesday-Friday and Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday-Tuesday, at 609 Medary Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco John's at 609 Medary Ave., Brookings
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Wednesday-Saturday; open until 11 p.m. Sunday-Tuesday.

cards.title: Papa Johns on 6th Street South
cards.subtitle: 1833 6th Street South, Brookings
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout from this 6th Street South pizza shop, noting that carryout closes shortly before delivery on each day.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery reaches midnight most nights and 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday-Saturday; carryout runs until 11:45 p.m. or 1:45 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Delivery runs until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday-Saturday; carryout ends 15 minutes earlier.

cards.title: Domino's on 6th Street
cards.subtitle: 927 6th Street, Brookings
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order from the 6th Street storefront, and consult the location page again for the current daily close.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located pizza option whose official location page shows midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Brookings location page identifies the store at 927 6th Street and states it is open until 12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently shows the store open until 12 a.m.; consult it for the day-specific schedule.
